data.name: AKA - Akamai DNS failed lookups (excluding scanners and corporate domains)
data.description: Failed DNS lookups per client, with scanner subnets and corporate domains suppressed at detection time via CSV exclusion lists (akaExclScanners.csv, akaExclDomains.csv). MITRE ATT&CK: Command and Control / T1071.004.

scheduledParams.query: dataSource.name = 'Akamai' dns_rcode != 'NOERROR' client_ip = * | lookup excl_asset = reason from akaExclScanners.csv by cidr =:cidr client_ip | filter excl_asset = null | lookup excl_domain = reason from akaExclDomains.csv by value =:anycase query_domain | filter excl_domain = null | group failures = count(), domains = estimate_distinct(query_domain) by client_ip, query_domain | filter failures >= 25 | columns failures, domains, client_ip, query_domain | sort -failures | limit 200
